correctness.rationale: The Beta de Finetti representation, conditional reduction to the fixed-p random-addition threshold model, Diaconis-Holmes-Janson graph-limit theorem, motif-ordering formula, exact edge variance, and conditional Lindeberg argument were checked analytically.

originality.rationale: The 2026 model paper and classical threshold-limit and exchangeable-graph sources were checked together with searches for graphon, motif-density, edge-density, and fluctuation formulations. No prior statement of the explicit Beta-random threshold limit and the edge two-scale fluctuation package was located; residual generic-theorem risk is documented in REVIEW.md.

value.rationale: The result identifies the full random macroscopic limit, gives all fixed motif-density limits through an explicit order polynomial, and separates persistent reinforcement-driven density randomness from conditional Gaussian edge noise.

disclaimer: Not independent validation, peer review, or a guarantee of first discovery.
